Went to the Coventry v Wigan game, got to say it was one of the best performances I have seen in a while from Cov. We played with the young attacking trio of Maddison, Lameiras and Armstrong (18, 20 and 18 years old) and although they didn't have much of a physical presence they looked very sharp and creative. Armstrong scored two good goals; using his pace on the first and a deft finish off the post on the second. Our only problems were that the midfield was often lost in defence with neither Maddison, Lameiras and Armstrong able to provide any support. This exposed new signing Ricketts' lack of mobility and also meant they were often 2 on 1 with our right back. O'Brien was the only attack minded midfielder who provided support, often covering for Chris Stokes on the left. However, Ricketts, Johnson and Willis (Phillips after the break) managed to hold out. Wigan were poor, and never really looked like scoring. Overall it was an encouraging performance with only a few areas to work on.
